newsitem.title: CHINA: Iran oil minister to visit China, boost cooperation.
newsitem.headline: Iran oil minister to visit China, boost cooperation.

text.p: Iranian Oil Minister Gholamrezah Aghazadeh is to arrive in China on Thursday for a five-day visit for talks with Chinese officials on cooperation on exploration and boosting exports to China, officials said on Tuesday.
Aghazadeh would visit China as a guest of the China National Petroleum Corp, an embassy official said.
"The negotiations will about cooperation in the fields of oil and gas between the two countries," the official said, adding that talks could cover joint exploration in both China and Iran.
China and Iran currently have no joint ventures in the oil sector, the official said.
Iran was also eager to boost exports from the current 70,000 barrels per day to China, he said, adding that this was not a large amount.
"China has the capacity to purchase more and we hope to discuss this in meetings so that we can increase exports," the official said.
He declined to give further details of the talks.
Aghazadeh was due to leave on Monday, he said.
China's oil imports have risen sharply in past years, spurred by economic reforms.
